about: Operator allowlist for me_scraper.py. The Maine behavioral health board licenses organizations, not sites, and most of its 324 licences serve adults. Only entries with scope "in" are scraped and posted. "unsure" entries wait for the owner's decision; "out" entries record why a name that looks relevant was left out. Every licence not listed here is out. Checked against the full board list on 2026-10-01.

operators.name: SWEETSER
operators.why: Children's residential treatment (Saco, Winterport and other sites). Covers our records Sweetser Residential Treatment Center and probably Dirigo Place.

operators.name: SPURWINK SERVICES INC.
operators.why: Children's residential treatment and group homes across southern Maine.

operators.name: KIDSPEACE NATIONAL CENTERS OF NEW ENGLAND, INC.
operators.why: Operator of KidsPeace Graham Lake (Ellsworth), which we track.

operators.why: Operator of Good Will-Hinckley Roundel Residential, which we track. The board lists the licence under two names; the page uses the one the public knows.

operators.name: CONNECTIONS FOR KIDS
operators.why: Operator of Connections for Kids - Park Place Gorham, which we track.
